The note clings to Pip's fingertip while the cabinet stays untouched. Pip peels it with the free hand and it splits into two notes, one stuck to each hand. Pip presses both palms to the cabinet; they spring back and double into four notes, now dotting Pip's wrists. Pip backs away, arms out, and the four notes split into eight across Pip's arms and face. Pip freezes, eyes wide above a note stuck to the muzzle, and watches the last split finish. Pip deliberately lowers both arms and stops struggling. The still note-covered face turns toward the mirror. Pip holds still, breathing, until a sneeze bursts out and scatters the notes onto the cabinet.
